record.body:
verdict: NEEDS_WORK
findings:
  - task: move-effort-records
    kind: spec-gap
    expected: Efforts `dashboard`, `workflow-loop`, `packaging`, `session-analysis`, and `test-suite-speed` exist only in `~/orchestra/.artifacts`; this checkout holds `evidence-layer` only. Active goals here are `evidence-layer`; active goals in orchestra are the five moved efforts. Live `.artifacts/project-design.json` here is rewritten from `affidavit` to `orchestra` before the copy/split.
    observed: At phase HEAD `f677417`, `.artifacts/project-design.json` is still `"project": "affidavit"`. `handoff.md` and `project__active-goal` still list all six efforts (e.g. `rec-39db526b…` dashboard and `rec-f02f74d8…` evidence-layer). The five orchestration active-goal records are present in both checkouts. Orchestra git at `4038635` has no committed `.artifacts/` (untracked tree on disk mirrors the same multi-effort handoff). A later commit `3517afd` on the branch attempts a split but is not phase HEAD.
    severity: blocker
  - task: strip-affidavit
    kind: spec-gap
    expected: After the split, this repo is the evidence layer; agent-facing docs should not still describe installing skills/dashboard from this tree or stopping on foreign `"project"` other than the orchestra migration story in the plugin repo.
    observed: `AGENTS.md` and `README.md` still describe a full plugin (`skills/`, `dashboard/`, `init` skill, tmux dashboard keys, `dashboard/bin`). Code and `tests/test_evidence_layout.py` match the strip; docs do not.
    severity: judgment
integration:
  interfaces: Affidavit phase branch removes `skills/`, `dashboard/`, `scripts/`, `agents/`, plugin manifests, and orchestration tests; keeps `bin/aff` and `affidavit/{aa,aa_resolve,check,close_batch,verdict,manifest,amendment,oracle_red,cli,policy}`. `affidavit.aa` resolves stores via `affidavit.aa_resolve` with no `dashboard` import. New `~/orchestra` repo holds skills (seven slugs), dashboard, scripts, `agents/se-reviewer.md`, `orchestra.{reviewer,suite,project_field}`, bundled contract `"project": "orchestra"`, boundary scanner tests, conventional-commit skill snippets, and `aff check` / `aff close-batch` / `aff verdict` wiring in `execute-phase` and `verify-work`. Pytest at affidavit HEAD: 132 passed; targeted orchestra tests for boundary, project field, package layout, and task commits pass when run with `textual` / sibling `~/affidavit` on the path.
  assumptions: Graded trees at `affidavit--orchestration-split` `f677417` and `orchestra` `4038635` as given; orchestra `.artifacts/` read from disk though untracked in git; did not run `adaptive-artifacts validate` or full `verify-orchestration-split` acceptance commands per reviewer constraints; ignored execution reports and check-runs.
  invariants: No `tier2` module in either code tree; `affidavit` Python package does not import `dashboard` or `orchestra`; orchestra may import `affidavit` via `orchestra/__init__.py` path bootstrap; `affidavit/verdict.py` documents no artifact-store reads; skill scanner allows manual/review/suite `project:check-run` creates and forbids tdd/check runner creates and `project:oracle-amendment` creates/supersedes in migrated skill markdown; import-direction and verdict-store invariants hold in code, not in the split stores.
  conflicts: Store cut and active-goal acceptance conflict with current `.artifacts` layout at phase HEAD (orchestra store not committed; affidavit store still multi-effort). No code-level import-boundary conflicts found.
record.subject: orchestration-split-review
